description: This file defines an abstract class 'Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Collection' that represents collection-type values (arrays and structs) used in XML-RPC in the Zend Framework. It includes constructor logic to convert provided values into appropriate XML-RPC value objects and a method to extract native PHP array representations of the stored values.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Collection
classes.description: An abstract class representing collection types (arrays and structs) in XML-RPC, providing mechanisms to initialize values and retrieve their PHP array equivalents.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the collection object, converting array elements into XML-RPC value objects if they are not already.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the collection's values as a native PHP array by extracting each value from the XML-RPC value objects.
